provenance.geometry: UTUM Brick Coloration, slide 18; supplied by organizer
provenance.throughput: Organizer range 1500–3000 bricks/hour; 3000 selected as arrival target
provenance.product: Team assumption: one product per run; these shade names are illustrative
provenance.mechanism: Team concept: two-layer dehacking, whole-layer separation, two inspection lanes, selective robot correction, pairing, restacking; single gated infeed berth; separate inspection and correction positions; exclusively reserved join nests
provenance.timing: Engineering assumptions: durations derived from axis distances / configured speeds + explicit grip, settle, exposure and inference dwell. No acceleration model.
provenance.quality: Synthetic labels and simulated inspection; no camera or Person 1 integration; perfect inspection is an explicit demo assumption
provenance.mixing: Equal shade recipe is a team assumption. Budget 0 preserves good bricks; replacement choice favors distribution. Mixing is evaluated, not guaranteed.
provenance.mechanics: Whole-layer support/grip, robot reach, brick temperature/mass and contact mechanics remain unvalidated
